sql.description: Email-marketing statistics backfill: per campaign email a send-log message, 24 recipients (2 bounced), 3 tracked links and 13 clicks, so the backend Marketing dashboards do not read 0 sent / 0 clicked. Discovery-driven, and a clean no-op when the composition ships no campaign emails. Local installs only: an online build has no SQL surface and no route for this script (its effect ends in an UPDATE of a pre-existing EmailMarketingEmail row, which a merge SqlTable row cannot express).

The demo clock: the _demoClock anchor table (anchored to the day the FIXT-ORDER-RMA1 fixture dates were harvested, derived from that order, else the apply date), the exclusion and per-column guard tables, usp_DemoClockShift (discovers every operational date column from sys.columns and shifts it by whole days), and the daily RunSql scheduled task that runs it. Keeps every seeded date anchored to today after idle days. Local installs only: an online build has no SQL surface and no route for this script (DDL, a stored procedure and a RunSql task), so the 'Truvio demo clock' scheduled task exists on local-channel hosts only.

costHints.reservedKeyNote: The FIXT* family (base.contract.json idRules.reservedFixtureKeys FIXT* / FIXTGRP* / FIXT-PRICE-*, of which FIXT-ORDER-*, FIXTVG* and FIXTVO* are sub-families) plus the feature fixture families PACK-RPP-*, PACK-BOM-*, PACK-BOM3-* and PACK-SUB-* this layer seeds on behalf of feature-pricing, feature-bom-configurator and feature-subscription-orders (Foundry 960), disjoint from truvio-demo's TC* family. Int ids written verbatim with IDENTITY_INSERT by the serializer: AccessUser 1326 (IMCSalesrep) and 1328 (IMCUser) sit below the base contract's intIdentityFloor 100000 by contract (the contract-named exceptions in idRules.intIdentityNote); EcomRmaOrderLines 100301 is the reserved id of the PACK-RMA-0001 / FIXT-ORDER-RMA1-1 link, rekeyed on the harvest host because RmaOrderLineId is an identity-only key the engine never remaps and never warns on. The PACK-* families are recorded here until a base release adds them to idRules.reservedFixtureKeys.
costHints.expectedRowsNote: Rows arrive by merge deserialize of merge/_sql/<Table>/*.yml (3.0.0, Foundry #1215); every count equals the per-table SQL-route count measured on the harvest host (93 rows). EcomProducts 28 = 14 FIXT masters + 6 Size variant rows + 8 PACK fixture products. EcomGroups 8 = 3 FIXTGRP + 5 PACK. EcomPrices 8 = 3 qty tiers + FIXT-PRICE-CONTRACT + 4 PACK-RPP. The two local-only scripts add rows this count does not include (email statistics, the demo clock tables). Advisory: the gate derives its own counts from the composition.
costHints.usersNote: Buyer 1328 IMCUser and CSR 1326 IMCSalesrep ship as merge rows without a password: AccessUserPassword and the login and recovery columns are excluded by the predicate, and merge never overwrites a password set later. Set each password after the deserialize through Management API UserSetPassword, then recycle and verify with /dwapi/users/authenticate. AccessUserUserName is fixed at IMCUser / IMCSalesrep, the base contract anchors.
